import os,time,json,hashlib,re,math,threading,datetime,resource
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import psutil
import numpy as np
import duckdb
import pyarrow as pa
START=time.monotonic();PEAK=0;DONE=threading.Event()
ROOT=Path.cwd();MD=ROOT/'docs/serve_v1_pilot_families.md';OUT=ROOT/'docs/serve_v1_pilot_families.json'
H=Path('/Volumes/CATNAT_DATA/SIRETO_EMBEDDINGGEMMA2');SERVE=H/'serve_v1';PILOT=SERVE/'pilot_2000';G0=H/'step2_option_d_20261017/full';FT=H/'step2_gemma_finetune_10h_20261019/full'
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def sha(p):
 with Path(p).open('rb') as f:return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
def ref(p):return dict(path=str(p),size_bytes=Path(p).stat().st_size,sha256=sha(p))
def watch():
 global PEAK
 proc=psutil.Process()
 while not DONE.wait(.1):
  PEAK=max(PEAK,proc.memory_info().rss)
  if PEAK>3.75*1024**3 or time.monotonic()-START>3500:
   print('STOP_RESOURCE',PEAK,time.monotonic()-START,flush=True);os._exit(75)
threading.Thread(target=watch,daemon=True).start()
config=read(OUT);rules=config['rules'];protocol=MD.read_text().split('\n## Résultats\n')[0]
protocol_sha=hashlib.sha256(protocol.encode()).hexdigest();assert protocol_sha=='4ce6c4550e19530fd29419936132dbad126e67effaf20183848b9f08a4ac96c0'
rules_sha=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(rules,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
queries={'pilot':read(PILOT/'queries.json'),'bank':read(G0/'training_queries.json')}
assert len(queries['pilot'])==2000 and len(queries['bank'])==17427 and {q['fold'] for q in queries['bank']}=={2,3,4}
plan=read(G0/'plan.json');stock=plan['official']['stock'];assert sha(stock['path'])==stock['sha256']
source_paths=[G0/'training_queries.json',PILOT/'queries.json',Path(stock['path']),SERVE/'pooled_oof.npz',PILOT/'scored.npz',PILOT/'keys.npy',FT/'keys.npy',SERVE/'policy.json',H/'step2_risk_model_v1_20261020_c/full/data.json']
refs=[ref(p) for p in source_paths]
con=duckdb.connect(':memory:',config={'threads':'1','memory_limit':'512MB','max_temp_directory_size':'0B'})
flat=[q for name in ('pilot','bank') for q in queries[name]]
con.register('crm_surface',pa.table({'ordinal':np.arange(len(flat)),'name':[q['crm_name'] for q in flat]}))
normexpr=lambda name:rules['normalization_sql'].format(field=name)
names=[r[0] for r in con.execute('SELECT '+normexpr('name')+' FROM crm_surface ORDER BY ordinal').fetchall()]
print('INPUTS_QUERY_ONLY_VERIFIED',len(flat),flush=True)
# Exhaustive token-substrings: only matching enseignes are needed, not a national dictionary dump.
ngramset=set()
for name in names:
 words=name.split()
 for a in range(len(words)):
  for z in range(a+1,len(words)+1):ngramset.add(' '.join(words[a:z]))
con.register('wanted_brands',pa.table({'brand':sorted(ngramset)}))
parts=[f"SELECT siret,{column} enseigne FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE statutDiffusionEtablissement='O' AND {column} IS NOT NULL AND trim({column})<>''" for column in ('enseigne1Etablissement','enseigne2Etablissement','enseigne3Etablissement')]
sql="WITH e AS ("+' UNION ALL '.join(parts)+"), normalized AS (SELECT siret,"+normexpr('enseigne')+" brand FROM e) SELECT brand,count(DISTINCT siret) sites FROM normalized SEMI JOIN wanted_brands USING(brand) GROUP BY brand HAVING count(DISTINCT siret)>=?"
brand_counts=dict(con.execute(sql,[stock['path']]*3+[rules['brand_min_distinct_sites']]).fetchall());brandset=set(brand_counts)
print('ENSEIGNE_SCAN_DONE',len(ngramset),len(brandset),'seconds',time.monotonic()-START,flush=True)
density=dict(con.execute("SELECT codeCommuneEtablissement,count(*) FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE statutDiffusionEtablissement='O' AND codeCommuneEtablissement IS NOT NULL AND trim(codeCommuneEtablissement)<>'' GROUP BY 1",[stock['path']]).fetchall());con.close()
cutoff=int(np.quantile(list(density.values()),rules['density_quantile'],method=rules['density_quantile_method']));dense={k for k,v in density.items() if v>=cutoff}
admin=set(rules['admin_tokens'].split());org=set(rules['organization_tokens'].split());first=set(rules['first_names'].split());titles=set(rules['titles'].split());technical=set(rules['technical_phrases'])
generic=admin|org|set(rules['generic_brand_extra_tokens'].split())|set(' '.join(technical).split())
non_generic={b for b in brandset if not set(b.split())<=generic}
labels={'generique_administratif':'Générique / administratif','personne_probable':'Personne probable','sigle_abreviation':'Sigle / abréviation','enseigne_frequente':'Enseigne ≥50 sites','adresse_sans_numero':'Adresse sans numéro','commune_dense':'Commune dense','technique_vide':'Vide / technique','autre':'Autre nom'}
classification={};primary={};extra={};masked={};off=0
for cohort in ('pilot','bank'):
 rows=queries[cohort];flags=[];prim=[];secondary=[];examples={f:[] for f in rules['family_order']}
 for q,name in zip(rows,names[off:off+len(rows)]):
  tokens=name.split();letters=''.join(c for c in name if 'A'<=c<='Z');digits=sum(c.isdigit() for c in name)
  tech=not name or name in technical or (len(tokens)==1 and len(name)>=4 and digits>=len(letters) and digits>0)
  if not tech:
   for phrase in technical:
    if name.startswith(phrase+' ') and all(any(c.isdigit() for c in word) for word in name[len(phrase)+1:].split()):tech=True;break
    if re.fullmatch(re.escape(phrase)+r'[0-9][A-Z0-9]*',name):tech=True;break
  matched=set()
  for a in range(len(tokens)):
   for z in range(a+1,len(tokens)+1):
    value=' '.join(tokens[a:z])
    if value in brandset:matched.add(value)
  is_admin=bool(set(tokens)&admin);is_brand=bool(matched)
  person=bool(tokens and tokens[0] in titles) or bool(2<=len(tokens)<=4 and all(x.isalpha() for x in tokens) and set(tokens)&first and not(set(tokens)&(admin|org|set(' '.join(technical).split()))) and not is_brand)
  sigle=bool(not tech and letters and (len(letters)<=5 or (len(letters)>=2 and q['crm_name'].isupper() and not any(c in 'AEIOUY' for c in letters))))
  missing=not bool(re.match(r'\s*0*[1-9][0-9]*',str(q.get('crm_number') or '')))
  f=dict(generique_administratif=is_admin,personne_probable=person,sigle_abreviation=sigle,enseigne_frequente=is_brand,adresse_sans_numero=missing,commune_dense=q.get('crm_insee') in dense,technique_vide=bool(tech))
  f['autre']=not any(f[x] for x in ('generique_administratif','personne_probable','sigle_abreviation','enseigne_frequente','technique_vide'))
  flags.append([bool(f[k]) for k in rules['family_order']]);prim.append(next(k for k in rules['primary_priority'] if f[k]));secondary.append([bool(matched&non_generic),q.get('crm_insee') not in density])
  shape='[vide]' if not tokens else ' '.join(''.join('#' if c.isdigit() else '*' for c in word[:6])+('…' if len(word)>6 else '') for word in tokens[:6])+(' …' if len(tokens)>6 else '')
  for family in f:
   if f[family] and len(examples[family])<3 and shape not in examples[family]:examples[family].append(shape)
 classification[cohort]=np.array(flags,dtype=bool);primary[cohort]=np.array(prim);extra[cohort]=np.array(secondary,dtype=bool);masked[cohort]=examples;off+=len(rows)
binding={name:dict(rows=len(queries[name]),flags_sha256=hashlib.sha256(classification[name].tobytes()).hexdigest(),primary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(primary[name].tolist()).encode()).hexdigest()) for name in queries}
classification_time=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();print('CLASSIFICATION_FROZEN_BEFORE_INDIVIDUAL_STATUSES',classification_time,binding,flush=True)
# First individual statuses/hits access is strictly below the classification binding.
meta=read(H/'step2_risk_model_v1_20261020_c/full/data.json');assert meta['ids']==[q['query_id'] for q in queries['bank']] and set(meta['folds'])=={2,3,4}
policy=read(SERVE/'policy.json')['policy'];pooled=np.load(SERVE/'pooled_oof.npz');pilot=np.load(PILOT/'scored.npz');bhits=pooled['hits'];assert bhits.shape==(17427,2) and np.all(~bhits[:,0]|bhits[:,1])
scores={'bank':pooled['score'],'pilot':pilot['score']}
def tier(values):
 out=np.zeros(len(values),dtype=np.int8)
 if policy['probable'] is not None:out[values>=policy['probable']]=1
 if policy['sur'] is not None:out[values>=policy['sur']]=2
 return out
statuses={name:tier(scores[name]) for name in queries};assert np.array_equal(statuses['pilot'],pilot['tier'])
status_names=['A_VERIFIER','PROBABLE','SUR']
assert Counter(statuses['pilot'])=={0:1002,1:719,2:279} and Counter(statuses['bank'])=={0:5711,1:8091,2:3625}
def wilson(k,n):
 if not n:return None
 z=1.959963984540054;p=k/n;d=1+z*z/n;c=(p+z*z/(2*n))/d;h=z*math.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n+z*z/(4*n*n))/d;return [c-h,c+h]
def stats(cohort,mask):
 n=int(mask.sum());total=len(mask);z=statuses[cohort];values=scores[cohort][mask]
 result=dict(n=n,share=n/total,by_status={name:dict(n=int((mask&(z==i)).sum()),within_family=float((z[mask]==i).mean()) if n else None,share_of_status=int((mask&(z==i)).sum())/int((z==i).sum())) for i,name in enumerate(status_names)},risk_median=float(np.median(values)) if n else None)
 if cohort=='bank':
  result.update(union_correct=int(bhits[mask,1].sum()),union_accuracy=float(bhits[mask,1].mean()) if n else None,exact_correct=int(bhits[mask,0].sum()),exact_accuracy=float(bhits[mask,0].mean()) if n else None,union_wilson95=wilson(int(bhits[mask,1].sum()),n))
  for i,name in enumerate(status_names):
   part=mask&(z==i);nn=int(part.sum());k=int(bhits[part,1].sum());result['by_status'][name].update(union_correct=k,union_accuracy=k/nn if nn else None,union_wilson95=wilson(k,nn),exact_correct=int(bhits[part,0].sum()),exact_accuracy=float(bhits[part,0].mean()) if nn else None)
 return result
advice={
 'generique_administratif':'Ajouter le gestionnaire/exploitant et un libellé distinctif : un équipement ou une copropriété ne désigne pas forcément son entité juridique.',
 'personne_probable':'Préciser raison sociale/activité et occupant plutôt que propriétaire ; un particulier sans établissement professionnel identifiable ne devient pas siretisable avec son seul nom.',
 'sigle_abreviation':'Développer le sigle et fournir nom commercial/raison sociale ; la courte chaîne seule ne justifie pas de relâcher le seuil.',
 'enseigne_frequente':'Identifier le franchisé/exploitant local et le site exact ; enseigne fréquente ne signifie pas propriétaire ou SIREN unique, surtout pour les libellés génériques.',
 'adresse_sans_numero':'Ajouter numéro/suffixe ou position du site certifiée ; un numéro absent peut laisser hésiter les sites sans invalider nécessairement l’entreprise.',
 'commune_dense':'Compléter bâtiment/voie/numéro et exploitant ; densité et colocalisation réclament une preuve plus distinctive, pas un seuil plus permissif.',
 'technique_vide':'Remplacer code/équipement par occupant/exploitant ; une fiche limitée à un local technique sans entité juridique n’est pas siretisable avec cet export seul.',
 'autre':'Pas de signal unique : contrôler nom officiel/nom d’usage actuel et adresse, puis auditer erreurs de génération ou de classement sans inventer de vérité.'}
def family_record(name,pm,bm):
 a=stats('pilot',pm);b=stats('bank',bm);av=b['by_status']['A_VERIFIER'];accuracy=b['union_accuracy'];qual='non mesurable' if accuracy is None else 'bon' if accuracy>=rules['bank_good_union'] else 'mauvais' if accuracy<rules['bank_bad_union_below'] else 'intermédiaire'
 lowrisk=av['n']>=rules['minimum_low_risk_cases'] and av['union_accuracy']>=rules['bank_low_risk_recovery_union']
 return dict(label=labels[name],pilot=a,bank=b,representation_ratio=a['share']/b['share'] if b['share'] else None,pilot_minus_bank_averifier_contribution_pp=100*(a['by_status']['A_VERIFIER']['n']/2000-b['by_status']['A_VERIFIER']['n']/17427),bank_assessment=qual,good_top1_low_risk_candidate=lowrisk,advice=advice[name],masked_examples=masked['pilot'][name])
families={name:family_record(name,classification['pilot'][:,j],classification['bank'][:,j]) for j,name in enumerate(rules['family_order'])}
partition={name:family_record(name,primary['pilot']==name,primary['bank']==name) for name in rules['primary_priority']}
assert sum(x['pilot']['n'] for x in partition.values())==2000 and sum(x['bank']['n'] for x in partition.values())==17427
expected=sum(x['pilot']['share']*x['bank']['by_status']['A_VERIFIER']['within_family'] for x in partition.values() if x['bank']['n'])
missing_partition_mass=sum(x['pilot']['share'] for x in partition.values() if not x['bank']['n']);assert missing_partition_mass==0
bank_av=float((statuses['bank']==0).mean());pilot_av=float((statuses['pilot']==0).mean())
decomposition=dict(bank_averifier=bank_av,pilot_averifier=pilot_av,gap_pp=100*(pilot_av-bank_av),expected_with_pilot_family_mix=expected,composition_pp=100*(expected-bank_av),within_family_and_model_transport_residual_pp=100*(pilot_av-expected),causal=False)
same_siren={}
for cohort,path in [('pilot',PILOT/'keys.npy'),('bank',FT/'keys.npy')]:
 keys=np.load(path,mmap_mode='r');assert keys.shape==(len(queries[cohort]),100)
 order=pilot['top4'][:,:2] if cohort=='pilot' else np.argsort(-pooled['ranking'],axis=1,kind='stable')[:,:2]
 if cohort=='bank':assert np.array_equal(order[:,0],pooled['top'])
 idx=np.arange(len(keys));top=keys[idx,order[:,0]];second=keys[idx,order[:,1]];assert np.all(top!=second)
 same=np.array([bytes(a)[:9]==bytes(b)[:9] for a,b in zip(top,second)],dtype=bool)
 same_siren[cohort]=dict(all=stats(cohort,np.ones(len(keys),dtype=bool)),same_parent=stats(cohort,same),different_parent=stats(cohort,~same),by_status={})
 for i,name in enumerate(status_names):
  part=statuses[cohort]==i;nn=int(part.sum());kk=int((part&same).sum());obj=dict(n=nn,same_siren=kk,rate=kk/nn)
  if cohort=='bank':
   for tag,mask in [('same',part&same),('different',part&~same)]:
    count=int(mask.sum());correct=int(bhits[mask,1].sum());obj[tag]=dict(n=count,union_correct=correct,union_accuracy=correct/count if count else None,union_wilson95=wilson(correct,count))
  same_siren[cohort]['by_status'][name]=obj
 same_siren[cohort]['all']['same_siren']=int(same.sum());same_siren[cohort]['all']['rate']=float(same.mean())
secondary={name:dict(non_generic_brand=stats(name,extra[name][:,0]),commune_unrecognized=stats(name,extra[name][:,1])) for name in queries}
for r in refs:assert sha(r['path'])==r['sha256']
DONE.set();PEAK=max(PEAK,resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss);elapsed=time.monotonic()-START
result=dict(status='COMPLETE_READ_ONLY_DESCRIPTIVE',rules=rules,preregistered_protocol_sha256=protocol_sha,rules_sha256=rules_sha,classification_bound_before_status_utc=classification_time,classification_binding=binding,
 sources=refs,denominators=dict(pilot=2000,bank=17427),families_overlap=True,families=families,exclusive_name_partition=partition,decomposition=decomposition,same_siren_top1_top2=same_siren,
 official_brand_proxy=dict(min_distinct_sites=50,matched_frequent_enseigne_strings=len(brandset),candidate_substrings=len(ngramset),matched_non_generic_strings=len(non_generic),not_unique_company_or_current_national_network=True),
 density=dict(public_sites=sum(density.values()),communes=len(density),cutoff_sites=cutoff,dense_communes=len(dense),dense_commune_share=len(dense)/len(density),active_and_closed=True),secondary=secondary,
 controls=dict(no_fit=True,no_gemma=True,no_web=True,closed_sets_accessed=False,vm_or_pid8288_accessed=False,source_hashes_unchanged=True,nominal_assignments_persisted=False),resources=dict(wall_seconds=elapsed,peak_rss_bytes=PEAK,limit_bytes=4*1024**3,duckdb_limit_bytes=512*1024**2,spill=False),
 reproduction=dict(command='.venv/bin/python -c "import json; p=json.load(open(\'docs/serve_v1_pilot_families.json\')); exec(p[\'reproduction_program\'], {\'PROGRAM\':p[\'reproduction_program\']})"',note='Writes only these two aggregate reports; sources read only, scientific rules unchanged.'),reproduction_program=PROGRAM)
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
fmt=lambda v:'—' if v is None else f'{100*v:.2f}%'
lines=['## Résultats','',f'Run réel readonly : {elapsed:.2f}s, pic RSS {PEAK/2**30:.3f}Gio ; sans Gemma/web/fit, hashes des {len(refs)} sources inchangés. Protocole avant croisement SHA `{protocol_sha}` ; règles SHA `{rules_sha}`. Affectations figées à {classification_time}, avant lecture des statuts individuels, hashes dans le JSON.','',
 '| Famille (recouvrements) | Pilote n / part | Banc n / part | UNION top1 banc | Exact banc | AV dans famille pilote | Part des1002 AV pilote | UNION banc parmi AV |',
